availability.behavior: cheap factual availability for one exact anchor; never simulates
availability.cache_behavior: no availability cache server-side; per-anchor GET is cheap (factual reconstruction only)

error_taxonomy.200_supported_false: well-formed but un-simulatable state or plan; canonical eligibility reason_code (INVALID_TRIGGER, TARGET_NOT_PRESENT, RIVAL_NOT_PRESENT, CONFLICTING_INTERVENTIONS, INVALID_PLAN, NO_ELIGIBLE_TARGETS, UNSUPPORTED_INTERVENTION_KIND, wet/track/tyre/retired variants)
error_taxonomy.404_cache_miss: valid request with no precomputed artifact while live is disabled (explicit; never silent fallback)
error_taxonomy.422_counterfactual_request_invalid: malformed plan (unknown kind/compound/form, conflicts, forbidden extra fields: counts/seeds/modes); pydantic schema violations use FastAPI default 422 body
error_taxonomy.422_unknown_state: exact-anchor miss / malformed anchor / invalid reconstructed state
error_taxonomy.503: cache_invalid / parameter_unavailable; 500 internal never disguised as client error

availability.response_shape: {supported, reason_code, state_identity, season, scheduled_laps, leader_laps_done, drivers[{driver_id, decision_lap, remaining_laps, eligible_n_min/max, eligible, compound, status}], eligible_targets, supported_compounds, comparison_forms, multi_stop_capable, multi_driver_capable, rival_candidates, cached_comparison_identities, live_enabled, provenance, limitations}
supported_primitives: PIT_IN_N_LAPS with lap_offset_n in the per-driver eligible domain and requested_compound in the supported set

compare.cache_behavior: cache-first server-side; live_enabled=False in this deployment so uncached valid plans return explicit 404 cache_miss (verified live)

delta_signs.delta_expected_finish: BASE - ALT (positive = ALT improvement, lower finish)

compare.error_taxonomy: same as availability, plus 200 supported=false with lifecycle detail
compare.identity: POST /v2/counterfactuals/compare {race_id, anchor_driver_id, anchor_lap_number, anchor_state_time_s, comparison_form, base_plan?, alternative_plan{target_driver_ids, interventions[{target_driver_id, kind=PIT_IN_N_LAPS, lap_offset_n, requested_compound}]}, rival_driver_id?} — NO count/seed/mode fields exist
compare.parity_relation: PIT_IN_1_LAPS == V3.6 PIT_NOW; PIT_IN_2_LAPS == V3.6 PIT_NEXT_LAP (verified exact on the 2022-r01-R perez fixture)
compare.production_config: 5000 futures, common random numbers, complete valid pairs
compare.qualification: SIMULATOR-CONDITIONAL OUTCOMES UNDER CONTROLLED INTERVENTIONS; no causal alternate-history claim, no recommendation, no utility, no optimal-strategy claim

deep_link.contract: canonical ?race=&frame=&driver= via useExpertWorkspaceHydration (V3.10G); race + exact frame + intervention-target prefill only; intervention stays user-controlled; unknown race / out-of-range frame ignored fail-closed

counterfactual.race_state_representation: exact (race_id, anchor_driver_id, anchor_lap_number, anchor_state_time_s); server reconstructs factual RaceState(T); no nearest/interpolation

frozen_semantics_note: V3.10G consumes V3.6/V3.7 capabilities without altering them. No utility, no recommendation, no optimal-strategy claim on either surface.

availability.behavior: deterministic catalogue of cached comparisons; optional ?race_id= narrows to one served race
availability.cache_behavior: precomputed manifest served by V3StrategyService.describe_availability; pit wall caches per race module-level and matches locally

error_taxonomy.200_supported_false: well-formed but un-simulatable factual state with canonical unsupported_reason
error_taxonomy.404_cache_miss: cached mode with no artifact for the exact request (explicit; never silent fallback)
error_taxonomy.422_strategy_v3_request_invalid: unknown action/compound, duplicate or empty alternatives, unknown mode, extra production-forbidden fields (simulation counts)
error_taxonomy.422_unknown_state: exact-anchor miss / malformed anchor / invalid reconstructed state
error_taxonomy.503: cache_invalid / live_engine_disabled / parameter_unavailable; 500 internal never disguised

availability.response_shape: {entry_count, entries[{race_id, anchor_driver_id, anchor_lap_number, anchor_state_time_s, target_driver_id, master_seed, simulation_count, supported, alternative_count, comparison_identities, cache_key}]}

compare.cache_behavior: mode=cached serves a deterministic artifact previously generated by the same engine; explicit 404 miss when absent; pit wall never sends mode=live

compare.qualification: paired MC sampling uncertainty only; no utility, no recommendation, no optimal-strategy claim
